notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 – Balancing Update
notes.notes:
[h1]🩸 Veil of Sanity - Patch Notes v1.1.1[/h1]
[h2]Now Live – Chapters I & II Balancing Update[/h2]

Greetings, survivors.
We've just rolled out a new patch focusing on gameplay balancing, performance tweaks, and bug fixes across Chapter I: Echoes of the Carnival and Chapter II: Neuromare. Thank you for your continued feedback—keep it coming!

[h2][b]🎪 Chapter I: Echoes of the Carnival[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]🔧Buffs[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Sanity Drain reduced by 3.5%
[*] Stamina Drain reduced by 3.5%
[*] Stamina Regeneration increased by 5%
[*] Monkey Time duration increased by +1 second per iteration
[/list]
[h3][b]🧨 Nerfs[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Balloon Spawn Rate reduced from 25% → 20%
[/list]
[h3][b]🤡 Clown Speed Adjustments[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Walking Speed increased by +5%, +3.5% when enraged
[*] Jogging Speed increased by +5%, +3.5% when enraged
[*] Running Speed increased by +2.5%, +2.5% when enraged
[/list]
[h3][b]⚙️ Adjustments[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved clown movement behavior for smoother and more dynamic pathfinding
[/list]

[h2][b]🧠 Chapter II: Neuromare[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]🔥 Nerfs[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Ash Entity Buff movement speed by 2.5%
[/olist]
[h3][b]🐞 General Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Various stability improvements and minor bug fixes across both chapters
[/list]

🛠️ Stay tuned for more updates as we refine each chapter. Your feedback drives every patch—keep sharing your experiences!

💬 Join the community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/sUFyhnA5vk]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/sphereka_official/?utm_source=qr]Instagram[/url] for real-time news.

[b]See you in the shadows.
— Sphereka Studios[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 – Threads of Madness
notes.notes:
[h1][b]🕯️ Veil of Sanity - Patch 1.1.0 Notes[/b][/h1]
Thank you for supporting Veil of Sanity! This patch focuses on enhancing the player experience in both Chapter 1 and Chapter 2. We've made several quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, balance changes, and UI [b]adjustments based on your feedback.[/b]

[h1][b]🤡 Chapter 1: Echoes of the Carnival[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]✅ Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

• Fixed a checkpoint bug where items would duplicate or appear in the inventory without being picked up.

• Resolved a bug causing the clown to duplicate in the end sequence.

• Fixed a second interaction bug with checkpoint objects.

• Corrected various random bugs affecting gameplay stability.


[h2][b]⚖️ Balance Updates[/b][/h2]

• 🧠 Sanity Drain: Reduced by 10%, allowing players to stay sane a bit longer.

• 🏃‍♂️ Stamina Drain: Reduced by 5%, giving more room to move and survive.

• 🔄 Stamina Regain: Increased by 4% to improve pacing.

• 🎈 Balloon Clown Teleportation Rate: Decreased from 34% to 25% – you’ll have more breathing room now.

• 🤡 Clown Post-Rage Nerfs:
   [olist]
   [*] Walk Speed: reduced from 430 → 400
   [*] Jog Speed: reduced from 530 → 500
   [*] Run Speed: reduced from 800 → 680
   [/olist]

[h2][b]🧭 Gameplay & Visual Improvements[/b][/h2]

• Introduced new guide system when pressing [P] for controls and tips.

• New monkey indicators: A red dot appears above the monkey icon when in hand.

• Added a light guide to help navigate the monkey drop area.

• After picking up the monkey, a guide for controls has been added to assist players in using the monkey effectively.


[h1][b]🧠 Chapter 2: Neuromare[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]🗺️ Map & Gameplay Adjustments[/b][/h2]

•Adjusted layout in the jail section for better navigation and pacing.

• Relocated the skull jump scare for more impactful timing.

• Added a missing widget for door interaction.

• Updated ending widget visuals for clarity and consistency.


[h2][b]✅ Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]

•Fixed visible camera placement bugs during the ending sequence.

•Resolved main menu access bug preventing entry to Chapter 2.

•Added hover effect on "Play Chapter 2" in the main menu.

• Corrected inspect note close button hover visuals.

• Addressed various miscellaneous bugs affecting gameplay and UI.


[h2][b]⚙️ General Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h2]

• Settings: Fixed the "Max FPS set to 0" bug.

• UI: Fixed the taskbar naming inconsistency.


[b]📣 Your Feedback Shapes the Madness[/b]
Many of the fixes and improvements in this update came directly from you, our players. We're incredibly grateful for your detailed reports, suggestions, and passion for the game.

[b]We’re always listening[/b]—if you have ideas for improvements, feature requests, or gameplay tweaks, don’t hesitate to reach out on our community forums or Discord.
Together, we’ll continue shaping [b]Veil of Sanity[/b] into the best nightmare it can be.

[b]Discord link: https://discord.com/invite/sUFyhnA5vk[/b]

[b]Stay safe... and stay sane. 🎪[/b]

notes.title: Veil of Sanity - Patch Update (Version 1.0.1)
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Veil of Sanity - Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

Hello Players!
We've been carefully listening to player feedback, and we're thrilled to bring you our latest patch! Your insights help us improve the game, and we appreciate every comment, suggestion, and report.

[b][h2]Patch Highlights:[/h2][/b]
[b]1- Flashlight Guidance:[/b] After picking up the flashlight, an informative dialogue now appears to explain how to use it. (Applied to both Chapter 1 and Chapter 2.)

Sphereka Team
